entries.finding: Hetero v0.1.42 descends from upstream v0.1.42. The selected prompt files prefill.cpp and gemm.cu are byte-identical across the two pinned trees. Within the focused source set, the Hetero-only v042 deltas are in verify.cpp and generate.cpp; verify.cpp adds the zero-logits diagnostic, while generate.cpp adds PLE RAM reserve handling and pool-affinity reporting.
anchors: src/program/generate.cpp Hetero v042 diff adds PLE RAM reserve and affinity reporting
entries.interpretation: The shared prompt source narrows a source-level comparison but does not establish that runtime paths or outcomes are identical.

entries.finding: Prefill::run_impl gathers PLE rows ahead, lands them at layer 1, runs PLE before that layer's two halves, then executes half 0 (GDN or QSA attention) followed by half 1 (MoE/feed-forward); each half writes back to the residual. The head is outside run_impl, after prompt prefill in the token loop.
anchors: src/prefill/prefill.cpp:3852, 3908-3938 MoE combine and residual writes
src/program/generate.cpp:12193 prompt call; 12310 onward token loop/head
entries.interpretation: The diagnostic boundary after MoE is later than the attention/GDN half and PLE producer.

entries.finding: The main attention and MoE scratch region is sized to the maximum of the respective layouts and intentionally shared because the operations are sequential. PLE batch post-ops also carve the region before those halves. A probe reading ephemeral scratch must be ordered before later reuse.
entries.interpretation: Prefer completed outputs m.R or m.bo for a bounded scan; if checking shared scratch, check immediately after its producer.

entries.finding: The per-layer prefill report runs after moe_combine, stream-synchronizes m.cs, then copies and scans GU/H/Dm/bo. It reports the first layer with a bad MoE result for a chunk. The prompt-end report scans the last residual row, PLE history, and only the first 65,536 GDN-state floats. Neither probe identifies the first bad GDN/QSA/PLE activation before MoE.
entries.interpretation: The name 'first layer' means first reported MoE-bad layer in a chunk, not the first non-finite activation in the forward path.

entries.finding: The normal Prefill::run_impl path contains stream/event waits and chunk-boundary stream synchronizations but no cudaDeviceSynchronize call. STRATA_DBG_NAN adds a compute-stream synchronization and blocking host scans after MoE, plus a prompt-end synchronization/reads. STRATA_PF_STEP_SYNC=1 waits on compute and copy streams after named steps. The f16_inplace STRATA_DBG_NAN counter in gemm.cu is inside a HIP-only compilation branch and calls hipStreamSynchronize per FP16-output GEMM; it is not the CUDA Run66 path.
anchors: src/prefill/gemm.cu:51-67 HIP-only counter kernel; 798-812 per-GEMM hipStreamSynchronize
entries.interpretation: Do not equate a pass with a synchronization-heavy debug mode to a fix; the mode can change scheduling/overhead and has limited scan coverage.

entries.finding: The ordinary generator's head/logit validation counts non-finite logits when logits are read; all-zero finite logits are not an error there. Hetero's STRATA_DIAG_ZERO_LOGITS hook is in Verifier::run: after sampling and the compute-stream synchronization, if a sampled ID is zero it reads logits and reports finite/NaN/Inf/zero counts, finite argmax, range, id0, and id19. It is an output-stage probe, not a prefill activation probe.
anchors: src/program/generate.cpp:12310-12346 run_head, read_logits, and non-finite count
src/core/verify.cpp Hetero v042:2174-2234 STRATA_DBG_NAN and STRATA_DIAG_ZERO_LOGITS
src/core/verify.cpp upstream v042 ends the corresponding block before the Hetero diagnostic addition
entries.interpretation: It can characterize a bad head row but cannot say which earlier producer first made it bad.

entries.topic: cache loan, session state, and MTP
entries.finding: The generator plans a prompt cache loan, synchronizes/grows K/V before it marks lent experts non-resident, passes borrowed buffers to Prefill, then refills the borrowed slots after Prefill. session_zero clears the residual, GDN recurrence/conv state, QSA cache/indexer, PLE history, and PLE predecessor tokens. Prompt MTP KV fill is a per-chunk callback from residual rows and next prompt tokens, with a tail-window skip and optional STRATA_MTP_PREFILL_SYNC behavior; this draft KV is separate from the target session's GDN/QSA/PLE state.
anchors: src/program/generate.cpp:12131-12168 loan and prefill init; 12193 run; 12197 onward refill
src/core/mtp.cpp:1154-1168 tail window/sync policy; 1207-1248 MTP prefill
entries.interpretation: These are state/lifetime boundaries to preserve in instrumentation; no evidence here attributes the observed output to a reset or loan.

entries.finding: Run18's long1k review records a pass with H4 text and actual IDs equal while STRATA_DIAG_ZERO_LOGITS=1 was configured; the same review reports zero zero-logits diagnostic rows and marks finite/NaN/argmax details unavailable. That preparation used a v0.1.40.4 binary and PLE RAM, with STRATA_DBG_NAN absent. It is a different build/control and does not prove a v0.1.42 fix or finite logits.
anchors: run18 contract: STRATA_DIAG_ZERO_LOGITS=1, STRATA_DBG_NAN_absent=true, PLE mode ram, engine 0.1.40.4
entries.interpretation: The pass and absence of a diagnostic row are historical observations, not causal evidence.

entries.finding: A narrow future probe could be default-off and explicitly enabled to enqueue a finite-scan kernel on m.cs after PLE writes m.R, after the GDN/QSA half output, after MoE combine, and after each residual write. Each scan would atomically retain the first chunk/layer/half/stage/index in a device flag; the host would read that small flag at an already-existing chunk-boundary stream sync. Cross-stream producers must use their existing event/wait dependency before the probe. This avoids adding a device-wide synchronization or blocking host read after each GEMM, but the scan kernels, atomics, and final flag read add work and can perturb or mask a race; the probe is not a no-effect measurement.
entries.hypothesis_status: default-off instrumentation placement hypothesis only; not implemented, built, tested, or measured; timing perturbation may mask races; it does not identify a cause or propose a math fix
